display_long_description:
The world is on the brink of collapse. Wave after wave, nightmarish creatures emerge from the shadows to destroy you. Your mission: survive, resist, and fight back.

In Resist the Wave, every shot counts. Aim precisely, dodge attacks, and use sprinting to reposition yourself while managing your arsenal. The action unfolds in a vibrant, top-down 3D world designed specifically for Meta Quest.

Devastatingly Powerful Special Weapons: Purchase new weapons in the shop between waves using coins you collect from enemies.

Between levels, invest your coins in permanent upgrades:

Weapons — Increase your attack power
Health — Survive longer
Stamina — Run and dodge without limits
Medic Kit — Restore health in combat
Economy and Rewards

Each defeated enemy may drop coins that fly toward you. Use them wisely in the shop between waves or save to upgrade your equipment. Bosses always reward you generously.

Do you have what it takes to withstand the wave? The battle for survival begins now.
